name: Waystone
detailed_description:
Waystone is a dark fantasy open-world RPG where you'll shape a vast voxel world, craft powerful gear, and battle ancient evils to uncover forgotten lore.

The Wizard's Circle has spoken, and from the echoes of infinite tales, Waystone emerges. Prepare to step into a universe unlike any other - a sprawling, dark fantasy open-world RPG where the very fabric of existence is a tapestry of unfolding lore.

EXPLORE A SHATTERED REALM

Delve into a sprawling world shrouded in mystery and shadow. Discover unique biomes, each with its own dangers to overcome, resources to gather, and secrets to unearth. Carve your path through a land where the earth itself is yours to command.

BUILD YOUR SANCTUARY

Raise mighty strongholds or cozy hidden bases. With a voxel-based world, excavate deep into the earth and construct intricate structures within. Fortify your creations, expand your domain, and defend against the encroaching darkness.

GATHER, CRAFT, AND CONQUER

Survive by your wits and the strength of your creations. Gather diverse materials from the world to craft essential tools, formidable weapons and armour, and vital supplies. Progress by challenging formidable bosses, unlocking new recipes, and mastering the secrets of Waystone.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Dynamic Voxel-based World: Explore and reshape a massive, fully destructible world. Dig, build, and sculpt your environment on an unprecedented scale.

  • Intricate Crafting System: Master hundreds of recipes to create tools, weapons, armour, building components, and powerful enchantments.

  • Flexible Building System: Design and construct anything from humble shelters to sprawling underground cities, adapting to the unique voxel terrain.

  • Challenging Combat & Bosses: Face a variety of deadly foes and engage in epic boss battles that will test your skills and reward your victories.

  • Unravel an Ancient Story: Piece together a compelling dark fantasy narrative as you explore ruins, decipher forgotten texts, and confront the sources of corruption.

  • Deep Character Customisation: Create a unique character with extensive customisation options and flexible skill development.

  • Vast Open World: Journey through diverse and dangerous lands filled with unique encounters, hidden dungeons, and valuable resources.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060, 6GB, AMD Radeon RX 5600XT or Intel Arc A750, 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel core i5-10600 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070, 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT, 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
